context: Implementation of all 3 AI-consulting recommendations using Cloudflare Workers AI: real AI advisor, content moderation, AI mission generation.
shared_infra: functions/api/_ai.js mirrors the existing db.js pattern (requireAI, runChat) and always returns null on any failure so every caller must handle a fallback.
feature_1_advisor: The previously fake rule-based AI advisor now calls a real Cloudflare Workers AI model via functions/api/ai-advisor.js, instructed to hint without stating the answer directly. Falls back to the exact previous rule-based hint if the API call fails.
feature_2_moderation: functions/api/_moderation.js: fast keyword blocklist (always enforced) plus an AI secondary check that fails open on error. Applied to nickname setting on all 4 login paths (email + Kakao/Naver/Google) and to DM message sending. This closes a real gap -- there was no moderation anywhere before.
feature_3_mission_generation: functions/api/admin/generate-missions.js (secret-protected) generates new missions via structured-JSON prompting, validated and stored in a new ai_missions table. functions/api/missions.js lets the client fetch them. doWork() merges them with the static pool (1.5s timeout, never delays opening the mission screen). Also added escapeHtml() to mission rendering as a defensive fix found during this work.
action_required: Add an 'AI' binding in Cloudflare Pages Functions settings. Add an ADMIN_SECRET env var to use mission generation (POST /api/admin/generate-missions with secret/node/count). Re-apply schema.sql (new ai_missions table).

verification.syntax: node --check passes on game.js and all 6 new/modified backend files.
verification.ai_mission_merge_tested: Mocked the missions API, forced the cycle index to land on the AI mission, confirmed it rendered correctly.
verification.fallback_tested: With the API genuinely failing (404), confirmed the mission modal still opened with the static pool, no errors, no hang.
verification.regression_suite: Graph integrity, stuck-node escape, speed equalization, and standard playthrough all pass.
